correctness.rationale: An ellipsoid c+Q^{1/2}B_d has section support midpoint u.c and squared halfwidth u^TQu, while amplitude determines det Q, so all full profile data reduce to these measured quantities. Span{uu^T}=Sym_d gives an injective linear shape-matrix map and center recovery. For any subcritical view set a nonzero indefinite H exists in its kernel: if normals span R^d, any nonzero semidefinite H vanishing on them is zero; otherwise w orthogonal to normals gives H=wv^T+vw^T indefinite. det(I+sH) tends to zero at both ends of a bounded positive-definite pencil and attains each interior level twice; these two distinct ellipsoids have the same determinants, midpoints and halfwidths, proving strict lower bound even with known volume. Exact coordinate/bisector inversion yields Q_ij=s_ij-(s_i+s_j)/2 and |err|<=2epsilon. Inspected exact rational checker for d=2..7 and its explicit opposite offdiagonal same-determinant pair; these illustrate, not replace, general proof.
